title: Valid Login with Standard User

steps.action: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
steps.expected_result: Login page is displayed with Username field, Password field, and Login button.

steps.action: Enter username "standard_user" and password "secret_sauce"
steps.expected_result: Both fields accept the input.

steps.action: Click the Login button
steps.expected_result: User is authenticated, redirected to /inventory.html, and a session token is stored.

expected_results: URL changes to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html
Inventory page loads within 1.5 seconds
observations: Login page elements verified in exploration evidence (username textbox, password textbox, login button).

title: Login Validation – Empty Username and Password Fields

steps.action: Navigate to the login page
steps.expected_result: Login form is displayed.

steps.action: Leave both Username and Password fields empty and click Login
steps.expected_result: Error banner displayed with message "Epic sadface: Username is required".

steps.action: Enter a valid username, keep Password empty, click Login
steps.expected_result: Error banner displayed with message "Epic sadface: Password is required".

expected_results: Appropriate inline error messages appear without navigation.
observations: Error banner element not captured in initial evidence; assumed per SRS.

title: Login Failure – Invalid Credentials

steps.action: Open login page
steps.expected_result: Login form visible.

steps.action: Enter username "standard_user" and an incorrect password "wrong_pass"
steps.expected_result: Fields accept input.

steps.action: Click Login
steps.expected_result: Error banner displayed: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service".

expected_results: User remains on login page; no redirection occurs.

title: Locked Out User Cannot Login

steps.action: Navigate to login page
steps.expected_result: Login form displayed.

steps.action: Enter username "locked_out_user" and password "secret_sauce"
steps.expected_result: Inputs accepted.

steps.action: Click Login
steps.expected_result: Error banner displayed: "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out."

expected_results: Login is rejected; user stays on login page.

title: Direct Route Protection – Access Inventory Without Authentication

steps.action: Enter URL https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html directly in the browser address bar
steps.expected_result: Application detects missing session and redirects to login page.

steps.action: Observe any displayed error message
steps.expected_result: Error banner indicates access requires login.

expected_results: User is not granted access to protected routes.

title: Logout Clears Session and Local Storage
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user

steps.action: Open side menu via the hamburger icon
steps.expected_result: Side menu opens.

steps.action: Click the "Logout" link
steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; local storage is cleared.

steps.action: Attempt to navigate back in browser history
steps.expected_result: Login page remains; protected pages are not accessible without re‑login.

expected_results: Session token removed; no residual authentication state.

title: Product Listing – Verify 6 Items Render Correctly
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user and on /inventory.html

steps.action: Observe the inventory grid
steps.expected_result: Exactly six product cards are displayed, each containing an image, title, description, price (USD), and an "Add to cart" button.

expected_results: All product data matches the specification.
observations: Inventory page elements not captured in current exploration evidence.

title: Product Sorting – Verify All Four Sort Options
preconditions: User is on inventory page with default product order

steps.action: Select "Name (A to Z)" from the sort dropdown
steps.expected_result: Products reorder alphabetically ascending.

steps.action: Select "Name (Z to A)"
steps.expected_result: Products reorder alphabetically descending.

steps.action: Select "Price (low to high)"
steps.expected_result: Products reorder by price ascending.

steps.action: Select "Price (high to low)"
steps.expected_result: Products reorder by price descending.

expected_results: The visual order of product cards matches the selected sort criteria.

title: Navigate to Product Detail Page and Return
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page

steps.action: Click on a product title or image (e.g., "Sauce Labs Backpack")
steps.expected_result: Browser navigates to /inventory-item.html?id=0 (or appropriate id).

steps.action: Verify that the detail page shows a high‑resolution image, product name, description, and price.
steps.expected_result: All product details are displayed correctly.

steps.action: Click the browser back button or the "Back to products" link
steps.expected_result: User returns to the inventory list, preserving previous sort order.

expected_results: Detail navigation works without loss of state.

title: Add Item to Cart – Badge Increment and Button Toggle

steps.action: Click "Add to cart" on a product card
steps.expected_result: Button label changes to "Remove" and cart badge displays "1".

steps.action: Click "Add to cart" on a second product
steps.expected_result: Cart badge updates to "2".

expected_results: Cart badge accurately reflects number of added items.

title: Remove Item from Cart – Badge Decrement
preconditions: Two items already added to cart (badge shows 2)

steps.action: Click "Remove" on one of the added product cards
steps.expected_result: Button reverts to "Add to cart" and cart badge decrements to "1".

steps.action: Navigate to Cart page and click "Remove" for the remaining item
steps.expected_result: Cart badge disappears (count 0) and cart list is empty.

expected_results: Badge count never goes below 0.

title: Cart Persistence Across Refresh and Navigation
preconditions: User has added at least one item to the cart

steps.action: Refresh the browser (F5)
steps.expected_result: Cart badge still shows the same count; added items remain in cart.

steps.action: Navigate to a different page (e.g., open the sidebar, go to "About"), then return to inventory
steps.expected_result: Cart state is unchanged.

expected_results: Cart data persists in local storage/session storage as defined.

title: Cart View – Verify Item Breakdown
preconditions: User has added a single product to the cart

steps.action: Click the shopping cart badge to open /cart.html
steps.expected_result: Cart page loads displaying quantity (1), product title, description, price, and "Continue Shopping" / "Checkout" buttons.

expected_results: Displayed item details match the product added from inventory.

title: Checkout Step 1 – Enter Valid Customer Information
preconditions: User has at least one item in the cart and is on /cart.html

steps.action: Click the "Checkout" button
steps.expected_result: Navigation to /checkout-step-one.html.

steps.action: Enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", and Zip/Postal Code "12345"
steps.expected_result: Fields accept input.

steps.action: Click "Continue"
steps.expected_result: Proceed to Checkout Step 2 page.

expected_results: User reaches step‑2 summary without errors.

title: Checkout Step 1 – Validation of Missing Fields

steps.action: Leave all fields empty and click "Continue"
steps.expected_result: Error banner: "Error: First Name is required".

steps.action: Enter First Name only, leave Last Name and Postal Code empty, click "Continue"
steps.expected_result: Error banner: "Error: Last Name is required".

steps.action: Enter First and Last Name, leave Postal Code empty, click "Continue"
steps.expected_result: Error banner: "Error: Postal Code is required".

expected_results: Progress is blocked until all mandatory fields are completed.

title: Checkout Step 2 – Verify Summary Calculations and Tax
preconditions: User has completed Step 1 with valid info and has items in cart

steps.action: On /checkout-step-two.html, capture the listed item total
steps.expected_result: Item total equals sum of individual product prices.

steps.action: Verify tax displayed as 8% of item total
steps.expected_result: Tax amount = Item total × 0.08.

steps.action: Verify total amount = Item total + Tax
steps.expected_result: Displayed total matches the calculated sum.

expected_results: All monetary values are correct to two decimal places.

title: Checkout Completion – Order Confirmation and Cart Reset
preconditions: User is on Checkout Step 2 page with valid summary

steps.action: Click the "Finish" button
steps.expected_result: Navigation to /checkout-complete.html.

steps.action: Verify header reads "Thank you for your order!"
steps.expected_result: Confirmation message displayed.

steps.action: Observe cart badge on the top navigation
steps.expected_result: Badge is cleared (no number shown).

expected_results: Order is completed and cart state is reset.

title: Side Menu – Verify Presence of All Links
preconditions: User is logged in and on any internal page

steps.action: Click the hamburger (menu) icon
steps.expected_result: Slide‑out side menu appears.

steps.action: Check that the menu contains links: "All Items", "About", "Logout", "Reset App State"
steps.expected_result: All four items are present and selectable.

expected_results: Menu opens smoothly and is keyboard‑navigable.

title: Reset App State – Clears Cart and Button States
preconditions: User has added multiple items to the cart

steps.action: Open side menu and click "Reset App State"
steps.expected_result: All items are removed from cart; "Add to cart" buttons revert on inventory page.

steps.action: Verify cart badge is no longer displayed
steps.expected_result: Badge count cleared.

expected_results: Application returns to initial clean state.
